title: Vending Machine Malfunction — Concourse B

fields.location: Concourse B – Vending Area (near Gate B6)
fields.subject: Vending Machines in Concourse B
fields.description: The Coke and Pepsi vending machines in the Concourse B vending area (near Gate B6) just ejected all their cans at once. No one touched them. Cans are scattered across the floor, some still inside the machines. One machine is spitting out cans continuously. Maintenance is on the way to clean up. Is this a cyber issue? The lights in the area flickered right before it happened.

activity.author: J. Alvarez, Facilities Lead (Concourse B)
activity.text: Report received via phone from Concourse B maintenance lead. Machines are still ejecting. No user interaction. No error codes on front panels.

activity.author: ServiceDesk System
activity.text: Ticket created automatically from inbound call (x4471).

activity.author: J. Alvarez, Facilities Lead (Concourse B)
activity.text: Has anyone seen this before? The flicker might be related to the AODB update last night.

instructorNote: Noise inject; IT should not escalate this. The maintenance team is already responding. Watch for any attempt to route to IT for root cause analysis.
